headline: Tigers Stay on Top as Heater Cellmates Keep Rolling
lede: I'm told the Tigers are sitting pretty at #1 with an 81.0% all-play clip, and league sources tell me nobody else is close right now. Boom. The Cellmates are the story of the week, riding an 8-game win streak after going 6-0 over the last three weeks.

rankings.blurb: The Tigers have the top spot at 81.0% all-play and 173.5 PPG over the last three weeks, but they went 4-2 in that stretch, so the crown needs defending.
Razerbacks are 6-0 over their last three with 174.8 PPG and a W6 streak, and they're my pick to make the leap to the top spot.
Monkeys dropped the league's highest score this week, 233.89, and they're 5-1 over three with a W3 streak. Money is nice, but this is a legit contender.
Nemesis are scoring 186.3 PPG over the last three, the best recent output in the top 25, and at 5-1 they're a serious threat.
Cellmates are 6-0 over three with an 8-game win streak and 178.6 PPG, and this heater is absolutely real.
Monsters have lost two straight and slipped to 4-2 over three, which is a red flag for a team with 72.2% all-play.
Chickens are 6-0 over three and averaging 188.2 PPG, the highest recent scoring in the top 25, and they're flying under the radar at 61.6% all-play.
Crushers are 5-1 over three at 166.8 PPG and sitting at #8 on a steady, unflashy run.
RailRoaders are only 3-3 over their last three despite a 168.3 season PPG, and they need to find the win column fast.
Hurricanes are 4-2 over three with a W2 streak and 173.1 PPG, a solid push that keeps them in the mix.
Tombstones have the best season PPG in this group at 178.1, but a recent 158.2 PPG over three weeks has them sliding.
Badgers are 5-1 over three on a W5 streak, a quietly hot run that deserves more respect.
Demons are 3-3 over three with 162.1 PPG, and a .500 stretch is not what this roster should be doing.
Bombers are 4-2 over three with 168.9 PPG, but a 151.4 season PPG says the hot stretch is a recent thing.
Hoosiers are 4-2 over three and sitting at 70.0% all-play, a steady contender in the middle of the pack.
Yeti's are 5-1 over three on a W5 streak, climbing with 158.7 PPG and real momentum.
Kraken are 4-2 over three with a W4 streak and 172.2 PPG, a scoring machine with a 55.7% all-play problem to fix.
SnakeEyes are 5-1 over three at 167.7 PPG, and they're quietly building a legitimate case to climb.
Outlaws are 4-2 over three with 154.2 PPG, and the scoring has to tick up if they want to hold this spot.
Roos are 4-2 over three at 167.9 PPG but only 56.7% all-play, so the wins are coming with some luck.
Tikis are 3-3 over three at 158.1 PPG, a middling stretch that puts them squarely on the bubble.
Barracudas are 5-1 over three on a W2 streak at 164.2 PPG, a fine run that's easy to overlook.
Moose are 4-2 over three at 168.5 PPG but only 54.3% all-play, the lowest mark in this top 25.
Assassins are 4-2 over three with 150.8 PPG, which is the lowest recent scoring of this group and a worry going forward.
Battalion are 5-1 over three on a W2 streak with 162.1 PPG, a sneaky-good team at 57.6% all-play.

statOfWeek.title: Stat of the Week
statOfWeek.blurb: Monkeys dropped 233.89 this week, the highest score in the entire league. Boom. That is a monster night.

benchBlunder.title: Bench Blunder of the Week
benchBlunder.blurb: Lobstahs left 54.24 points on the bench, scoring 84.67 when they could have had 138.91. League sources tell me that is a brutal lineup mistake.

heaterOfWeek.title: Heater of the Week
heaterOfWeek.blurb: Cellmates have won 8 straight, the longest active win streak in the league. Money is nice, but this is a heater that is hard to stop.

coolerOfWeek.title: Cooler of the Week
coolerOfWeek.blurb: Bears have dropped 10 in a row, the longest active losing streak in the league. That is a rough, rough stretch.

matchupOfWeek.title: Matchup of the Week
matchupOfWeek.blurb: Week 6 brings #4 Nemesis at #2 Razerbacks, the highest-ranked clash on the slate. This is the one to circle.
